thesis: The speakers argue that traditional venture capital was historically underwhelming for entrepreneurs because partners only met with founders once a quarter, causing the value of that relationship to diminish to zero within three to four months. They explain that this realization, combined with the industry's contraction after the dot-com crash and the subsequent rise of active angel investing, led them to start a firm to provide better support and governance for startups.
